items.name: Gulaks
items.observations: Anthoxanthum odoratum: finely tufted perennial grass with mostly basal narrow linear leaf blades, several unbranched erect stems, five elongated dense green-gold to pinkish spike-like terminal panicles, paired fine leaf sheaths, a small membranous ligule and delicate yellow anthers. A narrow compact inflorescence rather than the long loose panicles of many meadow grasses makes this field-guide illustration visibly distinctive.
items.limitations: Illustrated group of five flowering stems is composed for legibility; the spikelets and nodding anthers are enlarged and colored with stylistic gold and pink touches. The delicate awns, spikelet structure and ligule lengths cannot reliably be measured from the drawing. It provides visual orientation for Anthoxanthum odoratum, not a stand-alone species diagnosis. Photo reference material remains available only to internal botanical reviewers.
